text:
nina.sdk: Heads-up: onboarding sample app on Android emulator (API 30) is sending duplicate uploads after a flaky carrier->wifi switch. Server received two POSTs with different request-ids. Debug logs show two concurrent calls to refreshToken() right before the uploads.

owen: Are you using a Retrofit call in an Interceptor to refresh? Doing network calls from an Interceptor is a common footgun. Interceptors execute on OkHttp threads and mixing coroutines can create races.

nina.sdk: Yeah, we wired refresh inside an interceptor because sample app did that. Code roughly: `if (isExpired()) token = runSuspendRefresh()` then attach header. We tried synchronized(this) but still saw doubles.

priya: Two things to check: 1) whether your request body is repeatable (if not, retries may fail differently); 2) whether WorkManager or a foreground job is re-enqueueing the same intent while refresh is in-flight.

owen: Another approach: implement refresh coalescing in a TokenStore that returns a hot Deferred/CompletableFuture for the active refresh. When a refresh is ongoing, callers await the same future instead of launching a new one. That works better than synchronized because it plays nicely with coroutines.

nina.sdk: Good idea. Is there a Kotlin/JS-safe pattern we should prefer over runBlocking in Authenticator? I tried runBlocking in Authenticator and it deadlocked once under load.

priya: Authenticator runs on OkHttp threads synchronously. If your refresh uses the same OkHttp client, runBlocking can deadlock because the client thread pool is exhausted. Either use a separate client for auth (small, dedicated) or have the Authenticator only signal and let a background coroutine perform refresh+notify.

owen: Also add an Idempotency-Key header to uploads. Server-side dedupe is simpler than trying to handle every race client-side.

nina.sdk: Plan: 1) replace interceptor refresh with TokenStore that coalesces refreshes via AtomicReference<Deferred<Token>>; 2) switch to Authenticator for 401 path but use a dedicated auth client (or hand off to TokenStore); 3) ensure uploads include Idempotency-Key; 4) add jitter/backoff on WorkManager retries.

ops-bot: Created draft PR: devex/samples/refresh-coalesce-tokenstore.kt and added note to docs/devex/auth-guidance.md (pr 4126).

nina.sdk: Thanks all, will try the TokenStore + dedicated auth client and report back if repro persists. Appreciate the tips :rocket:
